classic.geometry: Block and wedge forms, orthogonal silhouette
classic.surface: Studs on broad top faces; smooth on legible surfaces
classic.palette: Plastic with muted neutrals and strong primary color
classic.typography: Bold square header, plain readable labels
classic.icon_family: Pixel or monochrome with consistent outline
classic.depth: Small stepped shadow offset, no blur
classic.environment: Rectilinear modular buildings and visible joints
classic.character: Oversize shoulders only when role warrants
classic.detail: Visible top stud rows, exact pitch
classic.readability: Secondary patches aligned to major forms
classic.reject: Avoid glossy web pills and random cubes
classic.hierarchy: Large title or silhouette mass; smaller layered utility shapes
classic.lighting: Flat readable ambient with simple directional shadows
classic.shape_variation: Repeat a half-stud module; use wedges only where slope or silhouette requires
classic.transfer_test: Change role from zombie to miner without changing grid or limb ratio

simulator.proportions: Toy-like enlarged heads or hero item
simulator.border: Thick outline, large corners, asymmetrical badges
simulator.layout: Hero offer with large CTA, secondary card grid
simulator.typography: Heavy bold display plus restrained body
simulator.depth: Inner highlight and deliberate lower edge
simulator.character: Big paws, compact bodies, simple eyes
simulator.detail: Big rarity shape and text, no color-only
simulator.reject: Avoid uncontrolled gradients and uniform radius
simulator.hierarchy: Large hero item and action; small supporting counters
simulator.lighting: Broad cheerful key with clean highlights, no bloom dependency
simulator.shape_variation: Vary head/body/paw scale while retaining toy silhouette
simulator.transfer_test: Transfer pet card to egg offer while preserving item priority

rpg.surface: Wood, stone and metal material roles
rpg.palette: Muted base, brass accent, semantic rarity
rpg.border: Rectangular framed panels with corner emblems
rpg.reject: Avoid tiny ornate text or gold trim everywhere
rpg.hierarchy: Character or equipment leads; stats follow in aligned columns
rpg.lighting: Warm pools of light and controlled dark frame boundaries
rpg.shape_variation: Vary arch, trim and fabric masses by function
rpg.transfer_test: Convert equipment panel to crafting using comparison/detail grammar

anime.proportions: Exaggerated line of action, readable weapon
anime.surface: Flat grouped colors, sharp material boundaries
anime.border: Diagonal title wedge, selective thick strokes
anime.icon_family: Expressive silhouettes and sparse rarity marks
anime.depth: Flat layers and selective impact flash
anime.motion: Fast action after clear windup, held impact
anime.reject: Avoid rainbow gradients and constant camera shake
anime.hierarchy: Strong action line or portrait; small subordinate utility rail
anime.lighting: Graphic rim/key separation, limited high-energy accents
anime.shape_variation: Asymmetry follows actual movement and character role
anime.transfer_test: Change fast slash to heavy attack while preserving readability

scifi.palette: Dark neutral plus one status hue
scifi.border: Angular rails, segmented bars and bracket ends
scifi.layout: Instrument cells, status and loadout panels
scifi.environment: Modular bulkheads, visible access and vents
scifi.detail: Consistent fastener size and panel gap
scifi.inspection: Read at low graphics with bloom off
scifi.reject: Avoid all-neon forms and fake tiny labels
scifi.hierarchy: Readable system state first, decorative instrument labels last
scifi.lighting: Localized emissive strips, neutral surrounding structure
scifi.shape_variation: Use repeating bay widths with functional control variants
scifi.transfer_test: Convert loadout to navigation panel using same rails and status grammar

tactical.inspection: First-person FOV and low contrast scenes
tactical.reject: Avoid central giant panels in combat
tactical.hierarchy: Critical ammo/health first, optional text second
tactical.lighting: Low-glare lighting with strong functional recognition
tactical.shape_variation: Vary equipment by affordance and scale rather than ornament
tactical.transfer_test: Transfer status HUD from desktop to touch without covering crosshair

horror.proportions: Plausible scale, deliberate distortion for monsters
horror.depth: Soft separation, not black on black
horror.environment: Exit cues, dark/light rhythm and landmarks
horror.character: Asymmetric gait and distinct head silhouette
horror.reject: Avoid dark hazards and bloom noise
horror.hierarchy: Exit and threat information before atmospheric ornament
horror.lighting: Contrast paths from hazards without exposing every dark region
horror.shape_variation: Irregular wear follows stress and location, not random decals
horror.transfer_test: Change encounter from hallway to room with clear escape cues

pixel.typography: Pixel display with readable plain fallback
pixel.hierarchy: Large value/slot and consistent pixel rhythm
pixel.lighting: Flat tone steps; no smoothing-dependent readability
pixel.shape_variation: Vary silhouette in discrete steps, consistent pixel scale
pixel.transfer_test: Transfer item list to score table without changing icon sampling

cozy.geometry: Soft organic masses and gentle asymmetry
cozy.proportions: Comfortable human scale or chibi pet
cozy.palette: Warm neutrals, pastel accents with dark ink
cozy.environment: Clustered decor and readable walking paths
cozy.character: Rounded pet forms and expressive eyes
cozy.hierarchy: Friendly focal item; generous quiet supporting space
cozy.lighting: Warm diffuse shadows and soft accents, legibility maintained
cozy.shape_variation: Vary organic clusters and object mass with gentle asymmetry
cozy.transfer_test: Change daily tasks to decor catalogue with same calm hierarchy

minimal.border: Few thin borders; whitespace defines layers
minimal.layout: List or carefully spaced grid, dominant type
minimal.inspection: Small and large displays with real content
minimal.reject: Avoid generic glass cards and empty space without purpose
minimal.hierarchy: Primary text/action dominates; whitespace separates groups
minimal.lighting: Clean ambient and low-frequency surface contrast
minimal.shape_variation: Vary primary proportions and spacing, avoid arbitrary trim
minimal.transfer_test: Convert settings list to confirmation sheet without dense decoration

cyberpunk.motion: Controlled glitch accents with reduced motion
cyberpunk.reject: Avoid every edge glowing and visual overload
cyberpunk.hierarchy: One signal focal point per region; legible foreground
cyberpunk.lighting: Localized signs and broad dark shapes; check bloom off
cyberpunk.shape_variation: Layer modules in functional asymmetry with repeated signage rhythm
cyberpunk.transfer_test: Transfer contact screen to mission archive without extra neon

realistic.reject: Avoid high-frequency noise and excessive detail
realistic.hierarchy: Primary functional silhouette and measurable details
realistic.lighting: Neutral lighting to calibrate PBR, then target lighting
realistic.shape_variation: Vary real dimensions and material wear by use case
realistic.transfer_test: Transfer industrial prop to outdoor variant with physically plausible materials
